prose.headline: Sell AGNT short on a bounce to $4.20, aim for $3.04 by Nov 20, wrong on a close over $4.78.
story: AGNT fell 3.2% to $3.95 and slipped under its 50-day average at $3.97 and sits far below its 200-day average at $5.61. The stock has lost most of its value from the 52-week high of $12.23.
